false_negatives.finding: no_symlink_ancestry uses lexical Path.relative_to but never rejects '..' or checks resolved containment. A read-only regular payload at ../outside/forged.json is accepted by regular_readonly_single outside the supplied workspace.

Partitioned energy requires a common row-invariant rate but permits arbitrary direct_logic_pj_per_cycle values for each baseline/candidate row. Assigning 1e9 to B0 and 1e-9 to Ours passes and creates greater than 99 percent apparent energy reduction without changing charge.

address_trace_sha256 is only length checked. Sixty-four non-hex 'g' characters pass, and the transaction authority contains no separately sealed address-trace payload whose bytes must match the claimed digest.
The aggregate all_memory > 0 gate permits every DRAM byte in all rows and population keys to be zero as long as any SRAM traffic remains.
The same aggregate gate permits all seventeen SRAM read/write planes to be zero as long as any DRAM traffic remains.

Neither the frozen resource tuple, charge receipt nor transaction authority represents SRAM/DRAM latency or memory-stall cycles. Positive total cycles do not prove that nonzero memory latency was included.

production_authority_assessment.reason: The empty allowlist is fail closed today, but populating it would inherit the six semantic holes above. Generic producer/tool SHA fields alone also require role-specific Synopsys, VCS, capture and simulator receipt checks in the release review.

minimum_additive_successor: Reject absolute paths and '..' components before joining; resolve root and leaf and require resolved_leaf.relative_to(resolved_root), while retaining per-component lstat symlink rejection.

Use one admitted logic-energy rate per direct hardware branch across B0/B1/B2/B3/C2/Ours, or provide separately sealed native per-row PTPX evidence and do not present it as an equal-rate comparison. The requested Table-A equal-rate mode must enforce exact row equality.
Add the actual address-timed trace as a sealed transaction-authority payload; require a 64-lowercase-hex digest and exact byte match to that payload.

For every row and population key, require nonzero aggregate DRAM traffic and nonzero aggregate SRAM traffic in addition to exact 17-macro conservation. Any justified zero plane must be an explicit separately reviewed exception.
Add code-pinned SRAM read/write latency and DRAM response-latency/stall coordinates, and bind cycle totals to a sealed latency-aware simulator receipt.

Before populating the five production roles, add role-specific semantic requirements for final capture/hammer, VCS cycle evidence, Synopsys SAIF/PTPX and macro/transaction tools; then obtain a fresh different-author hammer.
